overview.title: Program Overview
overview.content: The StarStore Ambassador Program is an affiliate program designed for content creators, influencers, and community leaders. Earn monthly commissions by promoting Telegram Stars and Premium subscriptions. Join one of four tiers (Explorer, Connector, Pioneer, or Elite) and start earning today.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Submit your application through our Telegram Mini App or web portal. Applications are reviewed within 1-3 business days.

steps.title: Get Your Referral Links
steps.description: Once approved, receive your personalized ambassador dashboard with referral links and tracking tools.

steps.title: Share & Promote
steps.description: Share your referral links with your community through your channel, blog, or social media.

steps.title: Earn Commissions
steps.description: Each completed transaction through your links generates a commission (10-20% depending on tier).

steps.title: Receive Monthly Payouts
steps.description: Get paid in USDT on the TON network on the 1st of each month. No minimum payout amount.

questions.q: How do I join the StarStore Ambassador Program?
questions.a: Apply through our Telegram Mini App at https://t.me/TgStarStore_bot?startapp=ambassador or on the web at https://starstore.app/ambassador. Applications are reviewed within 1–3 business days.

questions.q: How long does it take to get approved?
questions.a: Most applications are reviewed within 1–3 business days. During high-volume periods, it may take up to 5 business days.

questions.q: Can I be an ambassador without a large following?
questions.a: Yes. We value quality over quantity. Many top performers started with fewer than 500 followers.
Commissions range from approximately 10% to 20% of qualifying transactions, based on your ambassador level. Only completed, non-refunded transactions count.
USDT on the TON network is recommended and free. Alternative methods may incur processing fees deducted from earnings. Payouts are issued on the 1st of each month with no minimum.

questions.q: Is there a limit to how much I can earn?
questions.a: No. There is no earning cap. Elite-level ambassadors also participate in revenue sharing.

questions.q: What happens if a customer gets a refund?
questions.a: Refunded transactions do not count towards your commissions. Only completed, non-refunded transactions generate commission credits.

questions.q: Can I change my payout method?
questions.a: Yes. You can update your payout method in your ambassador dashboard at any time.

questions.q: Are there any fees to join?
questions.a: No. The program is completely free to join. There are no startup costs or hidden fees.

questions.q: How often do I receive payouts?
questions.a: Payouts are issued automatically on the 1st of each month in USDT. There is no minimum payout threshold.
